messages:
sam-ml: Heads-up: I ran an initial smoke eval of the q4b-int4 variant on the new longprompt benchmark and we have a reproducible quality dip on the 'longform summarization' slice.

tara-curation: ugh, thanks for catching. Is this the same promptset we used for the original q4b bring-up?

sam-ml: It's the longprompt promptset v2 (includes ~12k long-context examples). We did a fuzzy dedupe at 0.85 Jaccard last week; might have removed anchors we relied on.

omar-labelops: quick question — are the flagged failures in a particular label cohort? I can queue a microgolden relabel if needed.

sam-ml: Good call. Failures concentrate in the 'multisentence timeline' cohort (roughly 1.3k examples). Precision drop ~6 pts vs baseline.

jie-eng: Could be kernel/quant drift for long kv-cache handling. Can you paste the eval command you ran?

sam-ml: Sure: 
```bash
python infra/eval/run_eval.py --model q4b-int4-staging --dataset datasets/longprompt_v2.jsonl \
  --slices timeline,multi_para --metric rougeL --seed 42 --batch 8
```

eval-bot: Deploy note: q4b-int4-staging rolled to 4 gpus at 2024-06-12T09:14:23Z. Perf profile: 420 token/s, KV memory 0.9GB/slot.

tara-curation: My hypothesis: during the dedupe we may have removed some canonical reference variants that were used to craft golden labels earlier. For stability we should expand the golden microbatch for timeline cohort by +300 examples and re-run label reconciliation.

omar-labelops: I can schedule a 600-example labeling batch (300 golden, 300 review) starting tomorrow. ETA for relabel artifacts ~48h. Need permission to bump labeler rate cap.

sam-ml: Please hold on gating the batch — I want to run a quick A/B test: q4b-int4-staging vs q8b-fp16 baseline only on the timeline cohort to see if it's quantization-specific.

jie-eng: I'll spin up a dedicated eval shard for that A/B and pin kernel flags to match the staging runtime.

tara-curation: If the A/B shows quant-specific regression, we should try two mitigation paths in parallel: 1) expand golden examples targeted at the failure modes; 2) run a short quantization retrain (calibration sweep) with sample importance weighting for long contexts.

omar-labelops: noted; I'll provision the label queue with instructions: mark hallucinations, truncation, and factual ordering errors. Will include a quick checklist for reviewers.

sam-ml: For traceability: I'll add a small eval harness diff that logs token-level divergence and top-k decoding differences. Putting it in PR: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/394

jie-eng: Also adding a small runtime flag to force KV prefetch alignment; we can A/B that during inference.

eval-bot: Eval run scheduled: thread=1745006789, ab_test_id=ab-tl-20240612, shards=5. Results ping in ~2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tara-curation: Thanks everyone. After the A/B completes we'll decide whether to proceed with the microgolden relabel or try the kernel/flag mitigation first.

sam-ml: FYI, I'll attach a short sample set (30 failure + 30 matched control) to the thread for quick eyeballs. :eyes:

omar-labelops: Got it — prepping annotation instructions and adding burnout guard.

jie-eng: Ping me once the evals finish, I'll run a kernel bisect if the pattern looks quant-related.

tara-curation: Slack action items: (1) sam attach sample set, (2) eval-bot post A/B results, (3) omar reserve label batch, (4) jie ready kernel bisect.

sam-ml: done — uploaded samples and short notes.

eval-bot: AB results: q8b-fp16 baseline > q4b-int4-staging on timeline slice by 5.9 rougeL (p=0.003). Full logs: /evals/ab-tl-20240612/results.jsonl

sam-ml: that's pretty clear. Recommend we run the microgolden relabel + quant calibration sweep in parallel.

tara-curation: Agreed. I'll update the golden set plan and open a tracking ticket.

omar-labelops: Label batch scheduled. Will report progress here. :white_check_mark:
